Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the bio snippet that said Charles Mingus was born in Nogales, Arizona but raised in Los Angeles, and incorrectly concluded he was “from Los Angeles, California.” This conflated “raised in” with “from/born in,” causing a pivot to California (and Los Angeles) instead of Arizona (and Phoenix). That wrong state selection would lead to the wrong race/city context and derail reaching the correct answer (Mario Andretti winning the 1993 Phoenix CART race).
